defect: Timelapse, storage protection, multi-camera mode, camera selection, Full Config and upload restore could overwrite a profile edit committed by an overlapping request.

reproduction.observed: Each competing writer created a third revision instead of rejecting its stale base.

change: Pass the request base revision through all HTTP config persistence entrypoints to the existing transactional reservation adapter. Preserve existing form/API error presentation; dedicated Timelapse and Storage pages return 409 on conflict.

targeted.scope: Two real Flask processes per case; independent temporary SQLite database, first committed profile retained, globals preserved, stale writer rejected, no queued effects.

additional_checks: HTTP writer guardrail requires expected_config_id in persistence calls.
Rejected Full Config reload and restore cleanup requests queue no task and preserve revision history.

deployment.rollback: Restore flask/views.py, flask/storage_settings.py, flask/timelapse_settings.py and modern_admin_settings_runtime.py from 300d22e7 or verified backup; reload Gunicorn. No capture restart or database restore.

limits: This protects overlapping HTTP requests, not sequential submissions from old open forms without a form revision token.
Snapshot restore already reserves its writer transaction and remains separately covered.
CLI and background configuration writers are outside the new HTTP guardrail.
Concurrency tested on SQLite; other databases not certified.
No production configuration changes or capture restart requested.
